svg.data-vd-steps: [[0, "A human sperm cell: specialised to carry the father\u2019s genetic information to the egg."], [1, "The tail beats to swim; the midpiece supplies ATP for movement."], [5, "When it reaches the egg, enzymes from the acrosome digest the egg\u2019s outer layer, and the haploid nucleus enters."]]
svg.title: The sperm cell
svg.desc: A human sperm cell with acrosome, haploid nucleus, midpiece full of mitochondria and a beating tail.
svg.text: About 60 µm long. Not to scale.

g.data-info: Beats from side to side to move the sperm towards the egg.
Packed with mitochondria that release energy by aerobic respiration, as ATP, for swimming.
Contains one set of chromosomes (23 in humans): half the normal number, so fertilisation restores the diploid number.
A vesicle of digestive enzymes at the tip of the head. They digest the jelly coat around the egg so the sperm can get in.

g.text: acrosome enzymes digest the egg’s jelly coat
